title: Soft Glam vs. Full Glam: Which Bridal Look Is Right for You?
excerpt: Choosing between soft glam and full glam can feel overwhelming, but your venue, vibe, and personal style make the decision easier.
content: Soft glam embraces luminous skin, neutral tones, and feathery lashes for a timeless, romantic finish that photographs beautifully in natural light. Full glam brings bold brows, dramatic liner, and intense pigment that commands attention in grand ballrooms and evening receptions. At Velora Bella, we help Fort Lauderdale brides explore both aesthetics during a personalized trial so your wedding day look feels authentically and confidently yours.
